# Gene annotations

```{r}
gtf <- read.table('../../docs/genes.gtf', header = FALSE, skip = 5, sep = "\t")
genes.info <- gtf[gtf$V3 == "gene", ]
colnames(genes.info) <- c(
  "seqname", "source", "feature", "start", "end", 
  "score", "strand", "frame", "attribute"
)

df <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(genes.info$attribute, ';', 7))
ENS.ID <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(df$V1, ' ', 2))$V2
gene.symbol <- as_tibble(str_split_fixed(df$V4, ' ', 3))$V3

genes.info$ENS.ID <- ENS.ID
genes.info$gene.symbol <- gene.symbol
genes.info$attribute <- NULL
head(genes.info)
```

# Differential gene expression analysis with voom transformation

```{r}
dge.analysis <- function(rna.expression, pheno.data, group.var, contrast.var1, contrast.var2) {

  # Convert group.var to a factor in pheno.data
  pheno.data$group.var <- factor(pheno.data[[group.var]])
  # Create design matrix - ensure factors are properly coded
  design <- model.matrix(
    ~0 + group.var + Gender + Age, 
    data = pheno.data
  )
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design)) # Clean column names
  print(colnames(design))
  
  # Create DGEList object
  DGEL.voom <- edgeR::DGEList(
    counts = rna.expression,
    samples = pheno.data
  )
  
  keep <- edgeR::filterByExpr(DGEL.voom, design = design)
  DGEL.voom <- DGEL.voom[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  DGEL.voom <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(DGEL.voom, method = "TMM")
  
  # Apply voom and get weights
  v <- limma::voom(DGEL.voom, design, plot = TRUE)
  DGEL.voom$weights <- v$weights
  DGEL.voom$design <- design
  
  # Estimate dispersion with weights
  DGEL.voom <- edgeR::estimateDisp(DGEL.voom, design)
  # Plot the genewise biological coefficient of variation (BCV) against gene abundance (in log2 counts per million).
  plotBCV(DGEL.voom)

  
  # Fit GLM with weights
  fit.ql <- edgeR::glmQLFit(DGEL.voom, design)
  
  # Test contrasts
  contrasts <- limma::makeContrasts(
    #test = group.varcommon_COPD - group.varControl_ES, # TODO fix this so I dont have to hardcode the contrast vars
    test = group.varSEO_COPD - group.varControl_ES,
    levels = design
  )
  
  ql.results <- edgeR::glmQLFTest(fit.ql, contrast = contrasts[, "test"])
  
  # Get results
  results.ql <- edgeR::topTags(
    ql.results,
    n = Inf,
    adjust.method = "fdr",
    sort.by = "PValue"
   )
  return(results.ql)
}
```


```{r}
# SEO
#pheno.data.RNA.SEO
#rna.expression.SEO
#SEO_COPD_Y_or_N

# SEO
results.SEO <- dge.analysis(
                  rna.expression.SEO,
                  pheno.data = pheno.data.RNA.SEO,
                  group.var = "SEO_COPD_Y_or_N",
                  contrast.var1 = "SEO_COPD_Y_or_NSEO_COPD",
                  contrast.var2 = "SEO_COPD_Y_or_NControl_ES"
                  )

head(results.SEO$table)
```

```{r}
file = "../../results/05_EQTm/assoc_CpG_GEX/1Mb_window_sig_CpG_GEX/fdr_sig_cpg_sig_CpG_GEX/significant_CpG_GEX.csv"
df.eqtm.genes <- read_csv(file, show_col_types = FALSE)
eqtm.genes <- unique(df.eqtm.genes$geneID)
```

```{r}
# Subset results to only include genes from eqtm analysis
df.results.SEO <- results.SEO$table

overlap.GEX.eqtm.genes <- df.results.SEO[rownames(df.results.SEO) %in% eqtm.genes, ]

# Apply FDR correction only for the 247 genes
overlap.GEX.eqtm.genes$FDR <- p.adjust(overlap.GEX.eqtm.genes$PValue, method = "fdr")

# Sort by adjusted p-value
overlap.GEX.eqtm.genes <- overlap.GEX.eqtm.genes[order(overlap.GEX.eqtm.genes$FDR), ]

sig.DGE <- overlap.GEX.eqtm.genes %>%
            dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05)  
dim(sig.DGE)

# get results with standard FDR correction for comparison
#head(results.SEO$table)
GW.overlalap.GEX.eqtm.genes <- df.results.SEO[rownames(df.results.SEO) %in% eqtm.genes, ]

sig.DGE.standard <- GW.overlalap.GEX.eqtm.genes %>%
            dplyr::filter(FDR < 0.05)  
dim(sig.DGE.standard)


```



# SEO

```{r}
# Set up output directory
result.dir <- "../../results/07_DGE/"
results.dir <- file.path(result.dir, "GEX_SEO_exSmokers")
#script.result.dir <- file.path(sig.dir, "nominal_sig_cpg_sig_CpG_GEX")
dir.create(results.dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


results.final <- overlap.GEX.eqtm.genes %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "ENS.ID") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(genes.info, by = "ENS.ID") %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "ENS.ID") 

# Save results
write.csv(results.final, file.path(results.dir, "SEOvsEXsmokers_DGE_results.csv"))
head(results.final)
```
